query: ChatGPT MCP app for API payments
answer_summary:
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables AI applications like ChatGPT to interact with external tools and services seamlessly. To facilitate API payments within ChatGPT using MCP, several solutions have been developed:

1. **MCPay**: An open-source infrastructure that integrates on-chain payments into any MCP server using the x402 "Payment Required" protocol. This allows ChatGPT and similar clients to make pay-per-call requests without relying on static subscriptions or API keys. MCPay handles the entire payment lifecycle transparently for both developers and clients. ([docs.mcpay.tech](https://docs.mcpay.tech/?utm_source=openai))

2. **Latch**: An open payment layer that brings x402 micropayments to any MCP server.
